shadows.name: hero-demo
shadows.purpose: Depth beneath the preserved report demo.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Glass control adapted from React Bits GlassSurface. Live implementation: src/components/site/glass-surface.tsx and site.css. Preview shows the CSS fallback.
components.css: .ds-button { background:#c4b0ff; color:#1a1430; border:1px solid #ffffff50;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff80,inset 0 -1px 2px #7450bb50,0 5px 14px -6px #08041260;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);background-image:linear-gradient(165deg,#ffffff30,#ffffff03 45%,#ffffff12); border-radius:999px; min-height:54px; padding:14px 24px; font:700 15px Manrope,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms; } .ds-button:hover {transform:translateY(-2px)} .ds-button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #a78bfa;outline-offset:5px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-button:hover{transform:none}}

components.name: Dark button
components.description: Glass control adapted from React Bits GlassSurface. Live implementation: src/components/site/glass-surface.tsx and site.css. Preview shows the CSS fallback.
components.css: .ds-button { background:#1a1430; color:#f5f2fb; border:1px solid #ffffff50;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #ffffff80,inset 0 -1px 2px #7450bb50,0 5px 14px -6px #08041260;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);background-image:linear-gradient(165deg,#ffffff30,#ffffff03 45%,#ffffff12); border-radius:999px; min-height:54px; padding:14px 24px; font:700 15px Manrope,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms; } .ds-button:hover {transform:translateY(-2px)} .ds-button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid #a78bfa;outline-offset:5px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-button:hover{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: A cinematic plum rehearsal stage frames the original report cards and Aawax. A second editorial preparation photograph, liquid glass controls and a speech-opening comparison add visual depth and useful interaction while preserving native scrolling.

rules.name: Preserve the product assets
rules.body: Keep the report cards, phone scroll and mascot recognizable.

donts: Add eyebrow labels or em dashes.
Restyle the coach application from this marketing specification.
